# Virtue Hearing Aid Center

> Hearing aid center in Montebello, California. Free hearing consultations, hearing assessments, hearing aid fitting and ongoing care with Christopher Medina, a second-generation hearing aid specialist. Medicare, MediCal and 50+ insurance plans accepted. 0% financing available.

## Business details
- Name: Virtue Hearing Aid Center
- Address: 134 S Montebello Blvd, Montebello, CA 90640
- Phone: (323) 530-0223 (call or text)
- Email: Virtuehearingaidcenter@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm. Weekends by appointment.
- Specialist: Christopher Medina, hearing aid specialist and founder
- Brands: Starkey, Oticon, Signia, ReSound, Phonak, Unitron, Widex

## Key pages
- [Home](https://virtuehearing.com/): services, insurance and financing, about, FAQ and contact
- [Book a free hearing consultation](https://virtuehearing.com/book.html): online booking calendar and request form
- [Hearing health blog](https://virtuehearing.com/blog.html): articles on hearing loss, hearing aids and tinnitus

## Services
- Free hearing consultation: about 30 minutes, no credit card, no obligation
- Hearing assessment: in-office evaluation, plus an online hearing test to take from home
- Hearing aid fitting: personalized recommendations and fitting
- Ongoing support: follow-up adjustments and free trial periods

## Payment and financing
- Medicare, MediCal and 50+ major insurance carriers accepted
- 0% interest financing for up to 24 months (subject to credit approval)
- CareCredit promotional financing on purchases of $200 or more
- In-house financing for patients who do not qualify for traditional credit
